condition: pd.read_parquet on a local path passes a Python file handle to pyarrow, and the process sometimes aborts with SIGABRT at interpreter exit. This happens when a ThreadPool worker drops the PyReadableFile and takes the GIL during finalization.
workaround: Use pyarrow.parquet.read_table(path, ...).to_pandas() so the file is opened natively and the reader holds no Python file object.
